description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called SignUpView used for user registration in the app. It contains form fields for name, email, password, and confirmation, integrates with an external authentication view model, and provides UI components for signing up and navigating to login.

classes.name: SignUpView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that presents a user registration form with fields for name, email, password, and confirmation, and handles user sign-up interactions.
